reason: I already give free meals to creators and have no idea if anyone comes because of them, so a free listing that tells me cost per customer is worth two minutes. I'll have my nephew set it up, but I'm not promising my counter will use it every day.
objection: When the rush hits my staff won't remember to ask for a coupon or punch in a PIN, so the numbers will say the creator brought nobody even when they did, and then the ₹200 a month won't come either.
would_change_my_mind: If redeeming ever takes more than one tap at the counter or I see it missing most customers in the first month, I stop using it.
